## Use case

Who needs this change, and what task is currently difficult?

## Proposed behavior

Show a small input/output or user-workflow example. Describe compatibility and configuration changes.

## Acceptance criteria

Explain how the change could be tested. Include alternatives considered and what is outside the proposal.
